# Generated Gherkin Scenarios

Feature: End-to-end form submission workflow for Automation Testing Practice site

Background:
  Given I open the "https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/" URL
  And I am on the homepage with the "GUI Elements" section visible

Scenario: Complete the main form workflow with highlighted and marked UI elements
  When I fill in the following details in the "GUI Elements" section:
    | Field    | Value              |
    | Name     | Roostai            |
    | Email    | roostai@zb.io      |
    | Phone    | 9999999999         |
    | Address  | Bangalore , India  |
  Then the entered values should be visible in the respective fields in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I select the "Male" radio button in the "Gender" field within the "GUI Elements" section
  Then the "Male" radio button should be selected in the "Gender" field within the "GUI Elements" section

  When I check the following days in the "Days" field within the "GUI Elements" section:
    | Day       |
    | Monday    |
    | Tuesday   |
    | Wednesday |
    | Thursday  |
    | Friday    |
  Then the selected days should be checked in the "Days" field within the "GUI Elements" section

  When I select "India" from the "Country" dropdown in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then "India" should be displayed as the selected country in the "Country" dropdown in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I select "Yellow" from the "Colors" list in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then "Yellow" should be highlighted in the "Colors" list in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I select "Dog" from the "Sorted List" in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then "Dog" should be highlighted in the "Sorted List" in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I enter "17/02/2026" in the "Date Picker 1 (mm/dd/yyyy)" field in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then "17/02/2026" should be visible in the "Date Picker 1 (mm/dd/yyyy)" field in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I enter "01/01/2026" in the "Date Picker 2 (dd/mm/yyyy)" field in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then "01/01/2026" should be visible in the "Date Picker 2 (dd/mm/yyyy)" field in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I select the date range "10/01/2026 – 10/03/2026" in the "Date Picker 3 (Select a Date Range)" field in the "GUI Elements" section
  Then the date range "10/01/2026 – 10/03/2026" should be visible in the "Date Picker 3 (Select a Date Range)" field in the "GUI Elements" section

  When I click the "Submit" button at the bottom of the "GUI Elements" section
  Then the form should be submitted and any confirmation or validation message should be displayed in the "GUI Elements" section
